runs.content:
**Investigation idea:** All four "Games" prototype stubs are real files after all — they were never missing, just filed under the wrong domain folders. Following up on the still-open 2026-07-11/2026-07-19 thread: raw/games/Mobile Wood Chopping Game.md and raw/games/Childrens Financial Literacy Game.md are exactly where expected, but the other two live elsewhere — raw/crypto/Crypto portfolio tracker.md (Claude project UUID 019de42b, created 2026-05-01) and raw/ai-tech/Project Planning interface.md (UUID 019de42c, created 2026-05-01) — found while checking Crypto's raw folder for today's focus-domain deep-dive. games/prototypes.md's table is still the single placeholder row it's had since 2026-05-01. This also partially informs the 2026-07-17 connection questioning whether Games' "Crypto Portfolio Tracker" is the same build as ai-tech/projects.md's active "Crypto App" — they're tracked as two distinct Claude project UUIDs, evidence against them being the same build, though not confirmation. Next step: transcribe all four prototypes into games/prototypes.md's table now, and cross-link the two off-domain raw files back to it.

**Investigation idea:** Burry's freshly-ingested circular-financing short thesis lands on the exact word idea-crwv.md's own analysis already uses to describe CoreWeave's Meta relationship. finance/investor-letters/source-burry-trading-post-2026-07-24.md argues AI compute demand is substantially "financed, off-balance sheet and not lit" — the critique behind his new/added NVDA and SOXX shorts. finance/ideas/idea-crwv.md's own Section 4 already describes CoreWeave's $8.5B investment-grade debt facility, collateralised by Meta's $19.2B backlog, in its own words as "circular but structurally sound as long as Meta's AI buildout continues" — the same mechanism Burry is betting against, one Finance subfolder over. Neither page cites the other. Next step: add a line to idea-crwv.md's Key Risks table citing Burry's circular-financing critique as a named external bear case.

**Cross-domain connection:** Burry's newly-added Micron short is a direct, named rebuttal to AI & Tech's own structural bull case for the same stock — and neither page, nor the year-old open idea about it, mentions the other. finance/investor-letters/source-burry-trading-post-2026-07-24.md shows Burry adding to his Micron (MU) short on 2026-07-24 as part of a basket (NVDA, SOXX, CAT, MU) built on the circular/off-balance-sheet AI financing thesis. ai-tech/data-hbm-supply-chain-2026-06-27.md independently ranks Micron as the fastest HBM market-share gainer (4%→21%) with HBM sold out through 2026-2027 — the structural-bull case behind the wiki's own still-open 2026-07-07 idea ("Micron has no Finance idea page... next step: /equity-analyst MU"). Fred's own paper-trading portfolio has stopped MU out twice on exactly the volatility this tension would produce. Next step: when finally running /equity-analyst MU, explicitly weigh Burry's critique against the HBM bull case.

**Resolved:** The Games four-prototype-stubs mystery (originally logged 2026-07-11, partially corrected 2026-07-19) — all four confirmed real, just scattered across raw/games/, raw/crypto/, and raw/ai-tech/ rather than missing.

Monday focus (Finance + Crypto): deep-read memory/index.md's Domain Content Status and Open Threads in full, Crypto - overview.md, Crypto portfolio.md (including today's raw/crypto/ folder listing, which surfaced the prototype-stub discovery), idea-crwv.md, and the newly-ingested Burry source page. Checked log.md for everything logged since the last thinker run (2026-07-26): portfolio-refresh, sector/growth-value trackers, and the live trading-portfolio briefing — nothing else in that set surfaced a new non-obvious angle beyond what's captured above.

**Investigation idea:** Crypto's own compensated-variance framework already names Bitcoin as the archetype case but has never been checked against Fred's two worst-performing tokens, which read as the textbook opposite. crypto/source-whalepump-variance-ev.md defines "compensated variance" as bounded downside with open upside, explicitly naming "Bitcoin and other highly asymmetric assets" as the model case, and its own See Also already cross-links finance/concepts/concept-kelly-criterion.md for position sizing. But $LUCKY and $TEST in Crypto portfolio.md are, by the page's own definition, uncompensated variance — -90%/-98% left-tail losses already realised (not merely a tail risk), CertiK 3.5/10 on both, with no articulated right-tail thesis anywhere in either position's Notes row. This is a different lens from the already-logged 2026-07-06 idea (Finance's fraud-detection red-flags checklist never run against the same two tokens) — that one is about governance/audit red flags, this one is about Crypto's own risk-sizing framework never being checked against its own worst positions. Next step: add a one-line compensated/uncompensated-variance verdict to $LUCKY's and $TEST's Position Notes rows in Crypto portfolio.md, using the Whalepump framework's own terms.

**Cross-domain connection:** Grantham's on-air "Bitcoin is heading to zero" call sits unchecked against Fred's actual, doubled-up Bitcoin exposure — real BTC plus a leveraged Bitcoin-proxy equity. podcasts/podcast-diary-of-a-ceo-billionaires-warning-crash-is-here.md has Jeremy Grantham dismissing Bitcoin as speculative and "heading to zero," part of the same track record (called 2000/2008/2021) that gives his other bear calls real weight elsewhere in the wiki. Fred holds actual Bitcoin in Crypto portfolio.md *and* holds MicroStrategy (MSTR) in finance/portfolio-overview.md — whose own Notes column describes it, in Fred's own words, as "Leveraged Bitcoin exposure via equity." A single already-ingested bear call is therefore a direct risk to two separate real positions across two domains at once, with MSTR compounding rather than diversifying the exposure (MicroStrategy's BTC treasury is itself debt/convertible-financed, adding equity-specific left-tail risk on top of BTC's own price risk). None of the three pages currently cite either of the other two. Next step: cross-link the Grantham episode/person page from both Crypto portfolio.md's BTC row and portfolio-overview.md's MSTR row as the wiki's own standing bear case against this compounded exposure.

Sunday focus (longest-since-deep-dive domain): Finance + Crypto's own dedicated rotation slot (Monday) was skipped twice recently (07-13 was its last real focus day, then 07-20 was skipped), making it the most overdue domain for a fresh read — deep-read Crypto's full page set (overview, portfolio, defi-watchlist, both company pages, the Whalepump variance source) plus Finance's portfolio-overview.md and Investment ideas.md. No new wiki activity had been logged anywhere since yesterday's thinker run, so both items above came from re-reading existing pages side by side rather than from new source material.
